 Follow Us On: News Education Today News Delhi declares November 16 holiday for Chhath Puja, Bihar schools shut till Nov 17 Delhi declares November 16 holiday for Chhath Puja, Bihar schools shut till Nov 17
 Delhi has declared November 16 a public holiday for Chhath Puja across schools, government offices, autonomous bodies and public sector undertakings. The Monday closure gives government employees a weekday break, while Bihar schools remain shut until November 17.
 Advertisement Delhi has declared November 16 a public holiday for Chhath Puja across schools, government offices, autonomous bodies and public sector undertakings. By: India Today Education Desk New Delhi , Nov 10, 2026 19:05 IST Last Updated Nov 10, 2026 19:05 IST Published by Princy Shukla Nov 10, 2026 19:00 IST The Delhi government has declared November 16, 2026, a public holiday for Chhath Puja, bringing a day off for government offices and other establishments under the national capital’s administration. The holiday falls on a Monday and will apply to schools, colleges, government offices, autonomous bodies and public sector undertakings.
 The decision comes as preparations gather pace for the four-day festival, which begins on November 13. The General Administration Department issued the notification on November 9, with the approval of the Lieutenant Governor. advertisement ❮ ❯ Read Full Story DELHI’S NOVEMBER 16 HOLIDAY: WHO WILL GET THE DAY OFF?
 The notification declares November 16 a holiday in schools, colleges, all government offices, autonomous bodies and Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs) functioning under the Government of the National Capital Territory of Delhi. The order was issued by Joint Secretary Pradeep Tayal and will be published in the Delhi Gazette, Part IV (Extraordinary).
 The department has circulated the order to government departments, ministries, administrative offices and municipal authorities for information and necessary action.
 BIHAR SCHOOLS ALREADY ON A LONG CHHATH BREAK
 Meanwhile, government schools across Bihar are closed from November 7 to November 17, 2026. The extended break covers the Chhath Puja period, with schools expected to reopen after the holiday window.
 Chhath Puja, also known as Pratihar Shashthi or Surya Shashthi, is dedicated to the worship of the Sun God. Devotees observe rituals and offer prayers to the setting and rising Sun, often gathering at riverbanks, ponds and designated ghats.
